# Go-to-Market Strategy Memo: Cedar Ridge Thermal Sensor Line
Commercial HVAC Monitoring Expansion | Q3 2026

## Strategic Objectives
- Expand commercial facility presence to capture 8% market share in industrial HVAC diagnostics by Q4 2027.
- Achieve gross margins above 45% across all hardware bundles.
- Deliver customer acquisition cost (CAC) below $420 with an LTV-to-CAC target ratio of 3.5:1.

## Cost and Pricing Breakdown

| Product Tier | Unit COGS | Standard Markup | Target MSRP | Target Unit Volume |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cedar Ridge Core | $140.00 | 75% | $245.00 | 12,000 |
| Cedar Ridge Pro | $220.00 | 80% | $396.00 | 6,500 |
| Cedar Ridge Enterprise | $310.00 | 90% | $589.00 | 2,200 |

## Target Segments and Channel Strategy
Primary buyers consist of mid-market commercial building operators managing 50,000 to 250,000 sq ft facilities. Regional mechanical contractors serve as key distribution partners.

- Channel partner agreements establish a standard wholesale discount of 15% off list price.
- Digital lead generation focuses on commercial facility managers searching for retrofit predictive maintenance.
- Because unit margins are highest on Cedar Ridge Enterprise, direct all outbound SDR cadence toward single-facility retail sites.

## Performance Projections and KPIs
Blended revenue projections based on targeted volumes yield $6,809,300 in hardware sales for the initial 12-month rollout.

- The blended gross margin of 47.8% meets the corporate threshold of 45%.
- Target customer acquisition cost is set at $420 per account across digital and event channels.
- The calculated payback period from annual software maintenance fees of $600 per year per account is 14.5 months.
- Paid pilot programs will launch across three metro regions starting 08/15/2026.

errors.quote: direct all outbound SDR cadence toward single-facility retail sites
errors.explanation: Cedar Ridge Enterprise is the top-tier, highest-cost hardware package and the target profile is mid-market operators with 50,000 to 250,000 sq ft facilities, so routing enterprise outreach to single-facility retail sites contradicts the tier positioning and target customer profile.
errors.fix: direct all outbound SDR cadence toward multi-facility commercial campus operators

errors.quote: Target customer acquisition cost is set at $420 per account across digital and event channels.
errors.explanation: The Strategic Objectives section specifies an LTV-to-CAC target ratio of 3.5:1, but the performance projection omits the projected customer lifetime value (LTV) required to evaluate whether the $420 CAC meets this threshold.
errors.fix: Target customer acquisition cost is set at $420 against a projected LTV of $1,470 per account across digital and event channels.

errors.quote: annual software maintenance fees of $600 per year per account is 14.5 months
errors.explanation: A $420 CAC recovered at $600 per year ($50 per month) yields an 8.4-month payback period ($420 / $50), not 14.5 months.
errors.fix: annual software maintenance fees of $600 per year per account is 8.4 months
